cm_intro.text: Critters come to my workshop for new friends. Let's make one!

cm_poke.text: Poke the clay to put in an eye!

cm_pull.text: Pull a leg out of the clay!

cm_pinch.text: Pinch the top to make a horn!

cm_press.text: Tap the pink spot, then press spots on!

cm_tapoff.text: Tap a part to take it off again.

cm_check.text: Let's check it against the card.

cm_change.text: Let's change it a little. Back on the turntable!

cm_tip_more.text: Count the eyes first. Then one more!

cm_tip_fewer.text: Count the legs first. Then take some away!

cm_open.text: Your own way! Any parts you like.

cm_end.text: Five new friends for your Critter Garden!

h_intro.text: A new egg washed up! Answer my questions, and every answer cracks the shell a little.

h_stones.text: Every stop you finish keeps the egg warm.

h_pie_halves.text: Which pie is cut into halves?

h_pie_thirds.text: Which pie is cut into thirds?

h_pie_quarters.text: Which pie is cut into quarters?

h_book.text: Into the Nest Book it goes, and off to the Critter Garden!

cm_wake.text: Pop it in the oven to wake it up!

garden_hi.text: Welcome to the Critter Garden! All your critters live here.

garden_empty.text: Make critters in my workshop, and they will come and live here!

pr_tip.text: Hmm, not quite. Have another look!

pr_quick.text: Now the quick ones! As fast as you can!

kc_intro.text: Race you! Every right answer is a boost!

kc_dots.text: No hurry! Look at the dots, then type.

kc_time.text: Time's up! Let's look at the board.

kc_win.text: You won! That was a great race!

kc_lose.text: That was close! Shall we race again?

kc_calm.text: We made it! What a race!

cm_l_make.text: Can you make a friend to match this card?

cm_l_press.text: Press spots onto its tummy. Tap a spot to take it off.

cm_l_count.text: How many of these parts can you see?

cm_l_same.text: Make the same number of this part as the friend on the left.

cm_l_big.text: Which critter is big? Tap it.

cm_l_small.text: Which critter is small? Tap it.

cm_l_long.text: Which critter has long legs? Tap it.

cm_l_short.text: Which critter has short legs? Tap it.

cm_l_longer.text: Which critter has longer legs? Tap it.

cm_l_shorter.text: Which critter is shorter? Tap it.

cm_l_taller.text: Which critter is taller? Tap it.

cm_l_orderLen.text: Tap the shortest legs first, then the middle ones, then the longest.

cm_l_orderHeight.text: Tap the shortest critter first, then the middle one, then the tallest.

cm_l_sortColour.text: Put each critter in the basket with its colour.

cm_l_sortSize.text: Put each critter with the same size on its basket.

cm_l_basketCount.text: How many critters are in this basket?

cm_l_most.text: Which group has the most critters? Tap the group.

cm_l_least.text: Which group has the fewest critters? Tap the group.

cm_l_pattern.text: These spots go round again. Press the next spots, then tap the tick.

cm_l_chooseTwo.text: Choose two paints for your own pattern.

cm_l_own.text: Press six spots with your two paints. Make them go round again, then tap the tick.

cm_l_repeat.text: Can you make it go round again? Tap a spot to change it.

cm_l_patternYes.text: A pattern! It goes round again!

cm_l_yourPattern.text: You made your own spotty friend. Lovely!

cm_l_grow.text: Look at each row of spots. Press the spots for the next row, then tap the tick.

cm_l_numberRow.text: The numbers grow by the same step. What number comes next?

cm_l_where.text: Horns on top, legs under, and spots on its tummy. Make it, then wake it up!

cm_l_above.text: Put the critter above the shelf.

cm_l_below.text: Put the critter under the table.

cm_l_beside.text: Put the critter beside the oven.

cm_l_more.text: More critters come to join them.

cm_l_now.text: How many critters are here now? Type it, then tap OK.

cm_l_graphAll.text: How many critters are in all three groups together?

cm_l_equalise.text: How many more of the first colour would make its group the same as the second?

cm_l_keyTwo.text: Look at the key. Each picture stands for two critters.

cm_l_tallyKey.text: Each stroke means one critter. A line across makes a group of five.

cm_l_compare.text: Feet on the same line. Now look at where they reach.

cm_l_patternTip.text: Look at one little group of spots. Then the same group comes round again.

cm_l_growTip.text: Count each row. How many more each time? Add the same step again.

cm_l_positionTip.text: Look at the shelf, the table and the oven. Where does our friend need to go?

cm_l_graphTip.text: Read the groups from the board. Look at the key and the counting marks.

cm_l_storyTip.text: Count the critters that are here. Some came, and some may have gone home.

cm_l_show.text: Let's do it together, one step at a time.

cm_l_end.text: You explored with the critters! Lovely work!

cm_l_garden.text: Our new friends are off to live in your Critter Garden!

cm_l_buildTip.text: Touch and count the parts. Match the picture.

kc_jump.text: Three in a row! A big jump!

cm_l_graphCount.text: How many critters are in this colour's group?

cm_l_graphMore.text: How many more in the first colour's group than in the second?

cm_l_sortTip.text: Look at each basket's tag. Match the colour or the size.

mw_intro.text: Make this wing the same as that one!

mw_match.text: Drag the shapes onto the matching places on this wing.

mw_stack.text: Make the same tower on this wing. Start at the bottom, then build up.

mw_end.text: They're off to the Critter Garden!

mw_show.text: Watch me. Let's do it together, slowly.

mw_twin.text: Here's a fresh butterfly. Have another go!

mw_turned.text: Turn the shapes with the turning buttons. Then press them into their places.

mw_find.text: Look at the card. Find a shape like that, and press it onto this wing.

mw_find_round.text: Find the round shape, and press it onto this wing.

mw_find_three.text: Find the shape with three straight sides and three corners.

mw_find_four.text: Find the shape with four straight sides and four corners.

mw_sort.text: Look at the signs. Drag each shape onto the wing where it belongs.

mw_sort_rolls.text: Round things can roll. A box stays on its flat side. Drag each shape to its wing.

mw_sort_flat.text: These shapes are flat. These are solid, with space inside them. Drag each shape to its wing.

mw_pattern.text: Make your own pattern! Drag shapes into the spaces. Tap a shape to take it off.

mw_together.text: Put the pieces together to make the shape on this wing. Use the turning buttons if you need them.

mw_dots.text: Make the shape on the card. Tap dots to join them, then tap your first dot to close it. The back button takes a stick away.

mw_build_triangle.text: Make a triangle, any size you like.

mw_build_square.text: Make a square, any size you like.

mw_build_rect.text: Make a rectangle, any size you like.

mw_dots_3.text: Make a closed shape with three straight sides.

mw_dots_4.text: Make a closed shape with four straight sides.

mw_dots_5.text: Make a closed shape with five straight sides.

mw_dots_6.text: Make a closed shape with six straight sides.

mw_parts_copy.text: Colour this much on your wing. Tap a part to colour it, or tap again to clear it. Then press the tick.

mw_parts_name.text: What is this coloured part called? Tap its name.

mw_fair_2.text: Which one shows halves? The parts must be the same size.

mw_fair_4.text: Which one shows quarters? The parts must all be the same size.

mw_grid.text: Make your rectangle match mine. Change the rows and columns with the buttons.

mw_grid_tiles.text: How many little squares are there? Tap how many.

mw_check.text: Press the tick when you're ready.

mw_sides.text: How many straight sides? Tap how many.

mw_corners.text: How many corners? Tap how many.

mw_angles.text: How many angles? Look where the sides meet, then tap how many.

mw_faces.text: How many flat faces? Tap how many.

mw_edges.text: How many edges? Look where the faces meet, then tap how many.

mw_solid_corners.text: How many corners does this solid have? Tap how many.

mw_more_sides.text: Tap the shape with more straight sides.

mw_more_corners.text: Tap the shape with more corners.

mw_fewer_sides.text: Tap the shape with fewer straight sides.

mw_fewer_corners.text: Tap the shape with fewer corners.

mw_same.text: If they have the same amount, tap the same.

mw_tip_corners.text: That one has corners. Find the round one!

mw_tip_round.text: That one is round. Look for straight sides and corners.

mw_tip_sides.text: Let's look closely. Count its sides and corners.

mw_tip_turn.text: Try turning it until it fits the space.

mw_tip_open.text: This one has a gap. A triangle must be closed.

mw_tip_curved.text: This one has a curved side. A triangle needs straight sides.

mw_tip_four.text: This one has four sides. A triangle has three.

mw_tip_count.text: Count the straight sides on your shape, then check the card. Sticks in a straight line make just one side.

mw_tip_cross.text: These sticks cross. Make a shape with no crossing sticks.

mw_tip_close.text: Join some more dots, then tap your first dot to close the shape.

mw_tip_name.text: Look at the picture and its name. Let's try it together.

mw_tip_repeat.text: A pattern repeats. Tap a shape to take it off, then try making the same little group again and again.

mw_tip_parts.text: Count the coloured parts on my wing. Colour that much on yours.

mw_tip_fair.text: Fair parts are the same size. Watch them lift and lie on top of each other.

mw_tip_grid.text: Look at my rows across, and my columns down. Make yours match.

mw_tip_sort.text: Look at the signs on the wings. Does this shape belong with these?

mw_tip_stack.text: Start at the bottom. Find the same solid for the next space in the tower.

mw_every_circle.text: Tap every circle, big or small, tipped or straight.

mw_every_square.text: Tap every square, big or small, tipped or straight.

mw_every_triangle.text: Tap every triangle. Look for closed shapes with straight sides.

mw_every_rect.text: Tap every rectangle, big or small, tipped or straight.

mw_every_cube.text: Tap every cube. Look for solids with square faces.
